title: Build a community of practice
summary: A community of practice is a group of people who share a craft and learn from each other regularly. It spreads good practice without needing a central team for everything.

beginner: Invite PMs to a regular, informal meeting.
Agree a simple purpose, such as sharing what worked.
Ask members to present real examples.
Keep a shared space for notes and resources.
intermediate: Grow the community around topics members care about.
Link it to the standards and training.
Ask leaders to give people time to take part.
experienced: Connect communities across product, design and engineering.
Give the community a voice in how practice evolves.
Support community leaders so it doesn't depend on you.

toolExamples.confluence: Keep a community space with notes and recordings.
toolExamples.notion: Keep a shared list of topics and resources.

pitfalls: Turning it into a lecture series
No time given to take part
